## WF99 – Error handler (error workflow of every WF)
Logs the failure (secrets redacted) in `workflow_errors`, raises a deduplicated alert, and – if an inbound message was being processed – marks it FAILED with exponential backoff (1 / 5 / 15 min). After 3 failures it goes to the **dead letter** state (visible in the console, `RETRY_MESSAGE` action).
Node-level: OpenAI errors fall back to rules; Postgres / Gmail / WhatsApp nodes retry before failing.
